Q: VSCode is ignoring .editorconfig settings for csharp files in certain folders A:

In my case I needed to set

"dotnet.autoInsert.enableAutoInsert": false

Having 1. ensured C# Dev Kit was installed, 2. no other formatters working (eg. prettier).

Q: PM2 logs crash with [TAILING] Tailing last 15 lines for [app] process (change the value with --lines option) A:

In my case, I use pm2 status to check correctly name of the app, then use pm2 logs --lines 50 [your app name].

Q: How to call Action on Button click from JQuery A:

You want to add the paramaters inside the Url.Action Method to avoid the / at the end of your host.

@Url.Action("PersonInfo","Home" , new {name=Model.Name, city=Model.City }) //I believe this will look at your routes and generate localhost:2526/John/JohnsCity

Are your paramaters part of your model? If so the above will work. If not than you can use 1AmirJalali answer but replace the / before appending the paramaters since if they paramaters are not part of your model then they are probably coming via javascript variables.

Q: Converting html special character in excel A:

Use this function to encode from html special character to string

Function HTMLToCharCodes(ByVal s As String) As String

    With New MSXML2.DOMDocument60
        .LoadXML "<p>" & s & "</p>"

        HTMLToCharCodes = .SelectSingleNode("p").nodeTypedValue
    End With

End Function
